title: Magnetic Confinement
description: A charged particle spirals round a field line and cannot leave it. Twist the lines into a torus and a plasma can be held off every wall. Unlocks the Pulsed Magnet Lab and the Tokamak's coils.

puzzle.goal: A magnetic field B pushes outward on whatever carries the current that makes it. Write the pressure P it exerts, with the permeability of the vacuum μ0.
puzzle.name: Maxwell stress
puzzle.ask: Find P in megapascals for B = @{B} T (m = @{m} H/m for μ0).
puzzle.method: The energy stored in a field is B²/2μ0 per volume; pressure is energy per volume.
